departments.create.title: Create department
departments.create.description: Create a department anywhere in the tree (code unique within the tenant; parent must exist; leader must be a user of this tenant). Tenant side only.
departments.get.title: Get department details
departments.get.description: Get a department with its ancestors, leader user name, child count and member count.
departments.tree.title: Get department tree
departments.tree.description: The whole department tree of the current tenant with direct member counts.
departments.update.title: Update department
departments.update.description: Update a department's name, leader, order, description and status (the parent is changed with departments.move).
departments.move.title: Move department
departments.move.description: Move a department under another parent or to the top level; moving under itself or a descendant is rejected.
departments.delete.title: Delete departments
departments.delete.description: Delete departments in batch; departments that still have children or members are rejected item by item.
positions.create.title: Create position
positions.create.description: Create a position (code unique within the tenant).
positions.get.title: Get position details
positions.list.title: List positions
positions.list.description: List positions with paging, keyword, filters and sorting.
positions.update.title: Update position
positions.update.description: Update a position's name, order, description and status.
positions.delete.title: Delete positions
positions.delete.description: Delete positions in batch; positions still referenced by memberships are rejected item by item.
memberships.create.title: Add department member
memberships.create.description: Add a user of this tenant to a department, optionally with a position; the first membership of a user becomes the primary one.
memberships.list.title: List department members
memberships.list.description: List memberships filtered by department, user, position or primary flag, with user, department and position names.
memberships.update.title: Update department member
memberships.update.description: Update a membership's position, primary flag, employee number, grade, hire date and order.
memberships.delete.title: Remove department members
memberships.delete.description: Remove users from departments in batch; when a primary membership is removed the next one becomes primary.
organization.department.in_use: Department '{id}' still has child departments or members.
organization.department.cyclic_move: Department '{id}' cannot be moved under itself or one of its descendants.
organization.position.in_use: Position '{id}' is still referenced by memberships.
organization.membership.exists: User '{userId}' is already a member of department '{departmentId}'.
organization.membership.user_not_in_tena: User '{userId}' does not belong to this tenant.
organization.tenant_only: Organization is managed from the tenant side only.
